It ends at 00B8: the _DATA-segment fixup of fd_55B3_00B4 (S27 #1049) follows every entry of the 00B8-1811 object (#570-#1048) inside the program's _DATA group, where objects appear in descending address order (7DA8.., 205F, 1C62, 19A9, 15F8, 00B8-object, 00B4), so it is an earlier object than 00B8-1811. No code module references 0064-00B7 through its own segment; no code module links before root:0000. Whether 0064 (pointer) and 0068-00B7 (song record) are one file or two is not decidable from the image (no fixup or fill between them); taken as one.
